ai_summary: Three ByteDance 'smash-face' model bundles (face detection base, extra/eye refinement, age attribute) plus the ByteNN/espresso runtime. The bundle container is decoded (header, per-record names, 32-byte per-file key, per-record blob with a descriptor-block size, descriptor block + raw weight data). The binary graph-descriptor schema inside the descriptor block is not recovered, so only the 'mean' data record (1905 float32 anchor geometry) is fully decoded; the four networks are reimplemented as ARCHITECTURE_ONLY in JAX.

No numerical reference runtime available.
